defaults.message: It would mean the world to us to have you with us on such a special day. Let us know if you can make it in just a couple of taps.

share.introNames: {{names}} are inviting you to their wedding
share.introGeneric: You are invited to our wedding
share.whatsapp: {{intro}}{{when}}. Here is the invitation, where you can also let us know if you are coming: {{url}}

meta.title: Wedding invitation
meta.description: You are invited to the wedding{{when}}. Let us know if you can come.
meta.descriptionNames: You are invited to the wedding of {{names}}{{when}}. Let us know if you can come.

unavailable.title: This invitation is not available
unavailable.text: The link may be mistyped, or the couple may not have published the invitation yet. Ask them for the right link.

gift.titleMoney: If you'd like to give something
gift.hint: The list is only a guide. If you'd like to give something from it, let us know first so it isn't doubled up.

deadline.closed: The deadline to reply has passed. If you still want to let us know, please get in touch with us directly.
deadline.closedOn: The deadline to reply passed on {{date}}. If you still want to let us know, please get in touch with us directly.

thanks.label: Thank-you card
thanks.phrase: Thank you for joining us and making this day unforgettable

view.laterSame: Afterwards, we'll celebrate at the same place

attending.label: Will you come to the wedding?

plusOne.label: Are you bringing a plus one?

thanks.title: Thank you!
thanks.yes: We've received your reply. We're so happy you'll be there!
thanks.no: We've received your reply. We're sorry you can't make it; thank you for letting us know.
thanks.plusOne: You're coming with a plus one.
thanks.plusOneName: You're coming with a plus one: {{name}}.

errors.name: Please enter your full name.
errors.attending: Let us know if you're coming.
errors.network: We couldn't send your reply. Check your connection and try again.
errors.nameTooLong: That name is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).
errors.plusOneTooLong: Your plus one's name is too long.
errors.messageTooLong: The message is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).
errors.unavailable: We can't receive replies right now. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many submissions in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.gone: This invitation is no longer available.
errors.closed: The deadline to reply has passed. Please get in touch with the couple directly.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save your reply. Please try again in a moment.

editor.title: Wedding invitation
editor.description: Make your invitation your own and share a single link: anyone who opens it can reply without creating an account.
editor.confirmClose: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving?
editor.loadError: We couldn't load the invitation. Reload the page and try again.

fill.upToDate: Your invitation is already up to date with your plan.
fill.updated_one: {{count}} field was updated from your plan.
fill.updated_other: {{count}} fields were updated from your plan.
fill.filledNote: ({{fields}}). Change anything you like: what you write is never overwritten.
fill.canFill: Empty fields can be filled in from your plan.

sections.whereNote: If something doesn't apply, leave it blank and it won't appear.

fields.messageHint: A few words of welcome for your guests.
fields.deadlineHint: Optional. After this date, the form closes.

place.name: Venue
place.mapHint: If left empty, “Get directions” will search for the address on Google Maps.
place.mapError: Paste a web address that starts with http:// or https://.

gift.label: Show the gift details
gift.helpList: Your guests will see the list of things you've saved in your plan (without what you already have).
gift.helpMoney: Your guests will see the IBAN or Bizum you've saved in your plan.
gift.emptyList: Your gift list has nothing to show yet. Add something in the gift details of your plan.
gift.emptyMoney: You haven't added an IBAN or Bizum in the gift details of your plan yet.
gift.notShown: You have a gift set up, but it isn't marked to appear on the invitation. Turn it on in the gift details of your plan.
gift.notChosen: You haven't chosen how to receive gifts yet (money or a list of things). Do it in the “Gift” step of your plan.

publish.label: Invitation published
publish.helpOn: Anyone with the link can view it and reply. If you unpublish it, the link stops working.
publish.helpOff: It's a draft for now: nobody can see it. Publishing also saves your changes.

link.label: Link for your guests
link.placeholder: Publish the invitation to get the link
link.unsaved: You have unsaved changes: save them so they show up at the link.

preview.caption: Stationery preview
preview.aria: Preview: the invitation on an envelope, with the thank-you card on top

toasts.badMapUrl: Check the map link: it must be a valid web address.
toasts.namesRequired: Enter the couple's names before publishing.
toasts.saveFailed: We couldn't save the invitation. Please try again.
toasts.published: Invitation published. You can now share the link.
toasts.unpublished: Invitation unpublished. The link no longer works.
toasts.unpublishFailed: We couldn't unpublish it. Please try again.
toasts.copyFailed: We couldn't copy it. Select the link and copy it by hand.
toasts.slugInvalid: Check the link: {{min}} to {{max}} characters, lowercase letters, numbers or _ only.
toasts.slugTaken: That link is already in use. Choose another one.

color.note: Pick a palette for the whole invitation. You can still tweak every colour.
color.customizeNote: Tap a colour to change it.
color.customActive: You are using a custom palette.
color.hexInvalid: Enter a valid HEX colour, for example #A28BC4.
color.adjusted: The text and background are too similar: on the invitation we automatically darkened or lightened the text so it stays readable.
color.legacy: This invitation uses the colours of its template. Pick a palette to change them.

envelope.note: By default it comes from the palette and changes with it. It shows in the preview and in “Save the date”; your guests don't see it.
envelope.manual: Colour picked by hand: it doesn't change when you switch palette.

background.note: This is how each background looks inside your card, with your palette. The table behind is always plain.
background.label: Background type
background.motifsNote: Watercolour drawings in the corners of the card. The central ornament changes with the motif.
background.ownArt: This style already has its own drawings

style.shared: The style is the same on the invitation and on “Save the date”: change it here and it changes there too.

slug.label: Custom link
slug.help: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (_) only, {{min}} to {{max}} characters.
slug.invalid: The link must be {{min}} to {{max}} characters long, with lowercase letters, numbers or _ only.
slug.taken: This link is already in use. Try another one.
slug.error: We couldn't check it right now; we'll check it when you save.
slug.mine: This is your invitation's current link
slug.moves: When you save, the previous link will stop working: share the new one. The replies you have already received are kept.

layout.label: Card layout
layout.note: How the date, time, venue and names are arranged on the card. “Save the date” uses the same one, except Side column and Block, which only change the invitation.
layout.invitationOnly: This layout only changes the invitation: “Save the date” keeps the classic one.
